english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that a person, place, or thing is famous or well known.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken adjective for a person, place, or thing that is famous or widely known.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when “known” means famous or notorious.
Use this only when the person is eminent because they are widely known or famous.
Use this for the well-known or widely recognized side of “prominent,” especially for people.

examples.english: That singer is very famous in Hong Kong.
examples.traditional: 嗰個歌手喺香港好出名。
